firm_data.firm_description: Seiden Law LLP is a global law firm headquartered in Manhattan specializing in high stakes litigation, arbitration, judgment enforcement, cross-border disputes & transactions, and economic sanctions. They work on behalf of companies, governments, high-net-worth individuals and defrauded investors and creditors.
notable_facts: The firm has a global reach.
Seiden Law has won multiple trials in US courts in the past two years, including against top global law firms.
The firm's team is diverse and multi-lingual, speaking Chinese, Spanish, German, Russian, French, Hebrew, Korean, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic.

email.subject: AI for Seiden Law LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Allen,

Seiden Law's global reach across high-stakes international litigation and arbitration means your team juggles complexity that most platforms simply weren't built for. We know because our founders spent years in similar trenches.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and efficiency in cross-border work.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office on Thursday, April 10 to share how we're helping similar practices compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
